title: Employee preventive-vaccination event communication - 2021
summary: A 2021 staff posting documents an on-site preventive-vaccination event coordinated at the RTEC Conference Room with Walgreens and communicated insurance-coverage guidance.

claims.claim: RTEC advertised an on-site vaccination event for October 1, 2021 in the RTEC Conference Room, with Walgreens providing flu shots and other listed preventive vaccines.

The 2021 posting stated that the listed preventive services were covered 100% by United Healthcare for employees with RTEC United Healthcare insurance and told employees with other insurance to verify their own coverage.

evidence.note: Historical benefits statement; not current-plan authority.

prerequisites: Confirm current vendor, vaccine availability, insurance coverage, eligibility/age guidance, and event logistics.
steps: Communicate date, location, time, available vaccines, and coverage caveats.
Direct employees with other insurance to verify coverage.
decisions: Which vaccines/vendor/coverage terms apply for the current event.
exceptions: Employees with insurance other than the identified RTEC plan were told to check with their insurer.
controls: Do not reuse historical age/coverage/vendor statements without current verification.
Do not record individual vaccination status in the generalized HR knowledge layer.
unresolved_questions: Does RTEC still coordinate on-site vaccination events?
What current insurer/vendor and employee communication process governs preventive-vaccine events?
automation_candidates: Annual wellness-event template with required current verification of date, vendor, coverage, eligibility, and insurer language before publication.

provenance.notes: Publisher source rendered and visually verified.
